questions.question: What does DNS do?
options: Turns names like example.com into IP addresses
questions.explanation: DNS is the internet's phone book: names in, numbers (IP addresses) out.

questions.question: You changed a DNS record, but some people still reach the old server. Why?
options: Old answers are cached for a while
questions.explanation: DNS answers are cached to keep lookups fast, so changes can take minutes to hours to spread.
